parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the resource is located.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The type of the resource. Valid values:

- ContainerGroup: ECI instance

- ImageCache: image cache

- DataCache: data cache

- VirtualNode: virtual node

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The list of tags. You can attach a maximum of 20 tags to a resource.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The key of the tag. The key cannot be an empty string. The key can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and it cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The value of the tag. The value can be an empty string. The value can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and it cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.
